# The Observer Pattern

The Observer pattern defines a **one-to-many dependency** between objects. When one object (the **Subject**) changes state, all its dependents (the **Observers**) are automatically notified and updated.

## Core Components

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| **Subject** | Maintains a list of observers and broadcasts changes |
| **Observer** | Defines an updating interface for objects that should be notified |
| **ConcreteSubject** | Stores state and sends notifications when it changes |
| **ConcreteObserver** | Implements the Observer interface and reacts to updates |

## TypeScript Example

```typescript
// --- Observer Interface ---
interface Observer {
  update(subject: NewsPublisher): void;
}

// --- Subject Interface ---
interface Subject {
  attach(observer: Observer): void;
  detach(observer: Observer): void;
  notify(): void;
}

// --- Concrete Subject ---
class NewsPublisher implements Subject {
  private observers: Observer[] = [];
  private latestNews: string = "";

  attach(observer: Observer): void {
    this.observers.push(observer);
    console.log("Observer attached.");
  }

  detach(observer: Observer): void {
    const index = this.observers.indexOf(observer);
    if (index > -1) {
      this.observers.splice(index, 1);
      console.log("Observer detached.");
    }
  }

  notify(): void {
    for (const observer of this.observers) {
      observer.update(this);
    }
  }

  publishNews(news: string): void {
    console.log(`Publishing: "${news}"`);
    this.latestNews = news;
    this.notify();
  }

  getNews(): string {
    return this.latestNews;
  }
}

// --- Concrete Observers ---
class EmailSubscriber implements Observer {
  constructor(private email: string) {}

  update(subject: NewsPublisher): void {
    console.log(`Email to ${this.email}: New article — "${subject.getNews()}"`);
  }
}

class SMSSubscriber implements Observer {
  constructor(private phone: string) {}

  update(subject: NewsPublisher): void {
    console.log(`SMS to ${this.phone}: Breaking — "${subject.getNews()}"`);
  }
}
